thread:
maya: Quick UX flag — on narrow widths the Stop control gets hidden behind the token pill; users can't interrupt streaming.

alex: repro'd on small viewport. stop button pushed off when sender name wraps.

jordan: suggestion: pin Stop to left of control row in compact mode, keep Regen right. collapse token to a micro-pill that expands on hover/focus.

maya: priority is a persistent interrupt affordance. token details are secondary.

sam: accessibility: expansion must work on keyboard focus too and token should have aria-label like 'Tokens used: 28'. also add aria-live for streaming status.

kevin: copy tweak: tooltip -> 'Interrupt generation (Esc)' so shortcut is visible.

alex: FE note: moving Stop is easy, but debounce the token expand to avoid layout jitter during streaming.

jordan: for compact token, use a bullet+number (• 28) that expands to full meter on focus/hover; aria-label reads count.

maya: inline banner on Stop? show 'Generation stopped — partial response' with Retry. announced via aria-live.

sam: +1. add keyboard reachable Retry and record analytics: interrupt bucket (early/mid/late).

kevin: QA checklist: 320px layout check, token accessible by keyboard, aria-live messages, Esc shortcut wired, analytics event.

maya: i'll mock and open a tiny PR. tagging @alex @jordan for review.
